facts.fact: Banco Nacional de Angola Aviso n.º 1/26 of 28 January 2026, made under article 6 of Lei n.º 40/20 of 16 December 2020 (Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola), enters into force on publication and repeals Aviso n.º 15/22 on non-bank acquirers and sub-acquirers.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola (Lei n.º 40/20)

facts.fact: Aviso n.º 1/26 of 28 January 2026 provides that only payment service companies authorised by the Banco Nacional de Angola under Lei n.º 40/20 may act as non-bank acquirers of payment terminals (TPA) and ATMs.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema de Pagamentos de Angola (Lei n.º 40/20)

facts.fact: Aviso n.º 1/26 of 28 January 2026, in force from publication, requires every non-bank acquirer to participate in the Multicaixa payment arrangement and be certified by the entity responsible for it, and bars a bank from refusing to represent a non-bank acquirer in interbank settlement.
